cli.app_about: Automated temporary root & KernelSU loader for vivo/iQOO devices
cli.app_long_about: A lightweight tool to acquire unlock-free temporary root, load KernelSU, and configure local ADB on vivo/iQOO devices with locked bootloaders.
cli.check_about: Inspect connected device and verify vulnerability status
cli.catalog_about: Fetch and match payloads from remote catalog
cli.run_about: Acquire temporary root and load KernelSU
cli.clean_about: Clean up temporary runtime files on device
cli.history_about: View or manage execution history logs
cli.arg_serial: Target device serial number (for multiple devices)
cli.arg_skip_ksu: Acquire root only; skip KernelSU driver loading
cli.arg_reboot_first: Reboot device first to ensure a clean state
cli.arg_force_payload: Bypass payload verification and force deployment
cli.arg_payload_dir: Directory to search for fallback matching payloads
cli.arg_dry_run: Verify and resolve payload without deploying to device
cli.arg_manager_apk: Path to local manager APK on PC for offline ksud extraction
cli.arg_timeout: Timeout in seconds for exploit execution
cli.help_subcmd: Print help for command or subcommand
